trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated:** Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (latest prod deploy) was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back:** First rollback attempt partially failed (us-east done, rollout halted), leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1 with an 18% error rate. A retry completed the rollout — all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on **v2.3.0**.
3. **Verified:** Service reports healthy in all regions with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which has paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback and verification.

Recommend following up with the on-call engineer on the root cause of v2.3.1 before re-attempting a deploy.
